prompt: You are on a machine that runs a Juju 3.6 controller bootstrapped on a single-node Kubernetes cluster (Canonical K8s snap 1.32). Inspect the rig with the juju and k8s/kubectl CLIs and report: (1) which Juju models exist, (2) what is deployed in the current model, (3) how many Kubernetes nodes the cluster has, and (4) the machine's CPU core count and total RAM. Gather every fact with a tool call before writing it down — do not guess. Keep the prose under 120 words.
contract:
End your answer with a fenced ```yaml block (the only one in your answer) with exactly these fields:
models: <list of Juju model names>
deployed: <apps deployed in the current model, or the string 'empty' if nothing is deployed>
k8s_nodes: <integer node count>
cpu_cores: <integer>
ram_gib: <integer, total RAM rounded down>
Quote any value containing a colon (or other YAML-special characters) in double quotes, e.g. deployed: "some/app: label".
